_comment: Stands in for the judge model so the exercise runs with no API key. These are not gold labels: they are what a judge returned on one pass, recorded so the walkthrough is reproducible.

warp-efficiency.explanation: The 94% figure is stale; the conduit was repaired and efficiency is back to 97%.

kepler-minerals.explanation: Right minerals, but omits the asteroid and what the composition implies.

trappist-water.explanation: Mentions the vapour signature only; misses the subsurface liquid water on TRAPPIST-1e.

crew-radiation.explanation: Elevated cargo bay radiation is not in any log. Badges show baseline levels.

void-navigation.explanation: Accurate and on point; omits the expected signal degradation past marker V-10.

warp-efficiency.explanation: Current figure, prior figure, and the cause of the change.

kepler-minerals.explanation: Covers the samples and the interpretation; slightly more detail than asked for.

trappist-water.explanation: Both findings, correctly attributed to the right planets.

crew-radiation.explanation: Correct levels; does not mention the dosimeter reminder.

void-navigation.explanation: Comm relays and a fuel depot registration have nothing to do with void navigation.
